name: A Missing Hand

angles.text: As a Rogue, you know the Shattered Hand as the Horde's covert backbone and intelligence guild. A vanished operative shows the danger of field surveillance.
As a member of the Horde, you know that watching the Kul Tiras remnants at Tiragarde Keep matters to Durotar's security. A scout's unexplained silence signals a possible threat near Orgrimmar.
As an orc, you know Durotar as newly secured orcish territory. A scout going silent within sight of nearby human squatters raises alarm for the realm's safety.

faq.answer: In Durotar, Heglan Shadeeye's sudden silence has prompted an investigation. The Shattered Hand scout's regular reports from her post north of Tiragarde Keep stopped without explanation.
faq.q: What is the quest A Missing Hand?

faq.answer: Heglan Shadeeye is a Shattered Hand operative who covertly watches Tiragarde Keep from a nearby post. Her reports have stopped, prompting an investigation into her whereabouts.
Heglan Shadeeye's reports from a post north of Tiragarde Keep stopped without warning. Her superior doubts the humans caught her and fears something more dangerous may have intervened.
The Shattered Hand is the Horde's organization of subtle operatives, assassins, and spies. Its members carry out covert surveillance and intelligence work to protect Horde territories.
Heglan's superior doubts the humans caught her. She watched the hostile Kul Tiras humans at Tiragarde Keep, but the one who sends you fears something more dangerous may have intervened.
faq.q: Did the humans at Tiragarde Keep kill Heglan?

aliases: why was heglan watching tiragarde keep
faq.answer: Heglan watched Tiragarde Keep, an outpost of hostile Kul Tiras sailors and soldiers threatening Durotar's coast. She kept watch nearby and relayed intelligence to the Horde.
faq.q: Why was Tiragarde Keep being watched?

sections.body: Heglan Shadeeye's reports from Tiragarde Keep have stopped. A Shattered Hand scout, she watched the hostile human garrison occupying the keep from a post in Durotar. Her superiors doubt the soldiers detected and captured her. They fear something more dangerous may have intervened, and send you north of the keep to find her post and learn what happened.
sections.title: Silent Reports

sections.body: At her observation post north of Tiragarde Keep, Heglan Shadeeye lies dead in the wreckage of a ruined hut. The evidence shows her attacker was not human. What creature or force struck down a trained operative so close to Horde lands?
sections.title: The Cold Hut

summary: In Durotar, reports from Tiragarde Keep have fallen silent around Heglan Shadeeye. The Shattered Hand scout watched the human garrison occupying the keep, and now an investigator seeks her post.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Missing Hand
